mentions.heading: Additional environmental remediation or demolition obligations from facility divestiture and closure
mentions.detail: Facility sales, closures and demolitions worldwide may uncover unknown contamination; costs may exceed reserves
mentions.quote: We may identify previously unknown environmental conditions or further delineate known conditions that may require us to undertake remediation or incur additional costs related to demolition or decommissioning activities. Such costs may exceed our current reserves.

mentions.heading: Legal proceedings and commercial or contractual disputes
mentions.detail: Warranty claims and disputes with customers and suppliers, IP, personal injury, EHS, tax, employment matters
mentions.quote: While we believe our reserves are adequate, the final amounts required to resolve these matters could differ materially from our recorded estimates and our results of operations could be materially affected.

mentions.heading: Developments or assertions relating to intellectual property rights
mentions.detail: Large patent and trade name portfolio and numerous licensing arrangements; technological developments by others
mentions.quote: Developments or assertions by or against us relating to intellectual property rights could negatively impact our business. Significant technological developments by others also could materially and adversely affect our business and results of operations and financial condition.

mentions.heading: Taxing authorities could challenge historical and future tax positions
mentions.risk_name: Tax law change and rate increase
mentions.detail: OECD Pillar Two, expiry of tax holidays/incentives, EU and G20 changes to income allocation
mentions.quote: Our future effective tax rates could be affected by changes in the mix of earnings in countries with differing statutory rates and changes in tax laws, or their interpretation, including the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (“OECD”) Pillar Two Framework, and changes related to tax holidays or tax incentives.

mentions.heading: Taxing authorities could challenge historical and future tax positions
mentions.detail: Tax authorities may interpret laws differently and assess additional taxes beyond uncertain tax reserves
mentions.quote: While we believe that we have complied with all applicable tax laws, there can be no assurance that a taxing authority will not have a different interpretation of the law and assess us with additional taxes.

mentions.heading: Changes in tax laws, tax rates and adverse positions taken by taxing authorities
mentions.detail: U.S. Congress action could override treaties or deem company U.S. resident; reliance on Switzerland tax treaties
mentions.quote: If proposals were enacted that had the effect of limiting our ability to take advantage of the tax treaties between Switzerland and other jurisdictions (including the United States), we could be subjected to increased taxation.
